sources.title: What makes Qwen3.6-35B-A3B different from traditional dense models?
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a breakthrough open-source AI model combining 35B capacity with 3B active parameters. It delivers strong coding, reasoning, and multimodal performance at a fraction of the cost.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GGUF: Quants, Sizes, and How to Run It
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is the first open-weight model in the Qwen3.6 family, packaged as GGUF for local inference through llama.cpp and compatible tools like LM Studio, koboldcpp, Jan, and Unsloth Studio.
